# GamesRadar+

> > GamesRadar+ is a leading gaming and entertainment media outlet covering video game news, previews, reviews, industry analysis, and pop culture content including movies and TV shows.

GamesRadar+ provides comprehensive coverage of the gaming industry including major events like GDC and Future Games Show, developer interviews, game announcements, and entertainment news spanning franchises like Pokemon, Resident Evil, Street Fighter, and more. The site serves as a hub for gamers seeking news, guides, and analysis across platforms including PC, Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo.

## Key Topics

- Game Developer Conference (GDC)
- Future Games Show
- Pokemon Pokopia
- Friendslop genre
- Starfield and Bethesda RPGs
- Industry layoffs and development culture
- Xbox Project Helix
- Fortnite and Epic Games
- Capcom franchises (Resident Evil, Street Fighter)
- Indie game development
- Game trailers and announcements
- Cross-platform gaming
- Steam and PC gaming
- Entertainment adaptations
